methods.name: HDBSCAN: cluster tree, excess-of-mass selection, membership probabilities and GLOSH (dbscan::hdbscan)
methods.reference: dbscan::hdbscan(x, minPts) (dbscan 1.2.6: mst.cpp, hclustMergeOrder, computeStability, extractUnsupervised); dbscan::kNNdist(x, minPts - 1); stats::hclust(dist(x), 'single') for min_samples = 1
quantities: cluster tree: ids, parents, eps birth and death, stability, points at split, points leaving
no-split subset (labels; GLOSH by property) and exact-minPts split
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 115: labels, ids and counts exact; core distances, merge heights, eps birth/death 1e-8 relative (Tol::coef); stabilities, probabilities and GLOSH 1e-6 relative (Tol::stat)

deviations.quantity: membership probabilities when no cluster is found
deviations.note: dbscan 1.2.6 reports (max - coredist) / max over the root for every point although all are noise (case value nosplit_membership_prob_dbscan, not asserted); p2a reports 0, the value dbscan gives noise points whenever a cluster exists

deviations.quantity: membership probabilities when every member has core distance 0
deviations.note: dbscan's (max - coredist) / max is 0/0 = NaN (min_samples = 1, which dbscan does not allow, or duplicate points); p2a reports 1 (asserted for min_samples = 1 in test_validate_hdbscan_min_samples_one_is_single_linkage)

deviations.quantity: GLOSH outlier scores when no split exists
deviations.note: dbscan 1.2.6 leaves the root's eps_death at its unordered_map default 0, so every point scores 1 (case value nosplit_outlier_scores, not asserted); p2a computes GLOSH by its definition, 1 - eps_min / eps_p with eps_min the smallest merge height

methods.name: Silhouette widths (cluster::silhouette)
methods.reference: cluster::silhouette(x, dist) (cluster 2.1.6, C routine sildist): singletons and a(i) = b(i) score 0
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 115: widths 1e-8 relative (Tol::coef); averages 1e-6 relative (Tol::stat); neighbours and counts exact
